layout.repair: Compose layout containers with explicit spacing, sizing and clipping.

text.repair: Use native text with a bundled font, exact copy and measured line layout.

button.repair: Use a native control and verify its declared action.

range_option.repair: Replace the static range label with a native selector; bind selection to the chart and verify the resulting data change.

input.repair: Use a native input with editable value, focus and validation state.

toggle.repair: Use a native stateful control; inspect and change its value.

tabs.repair: Use a reusable native tab group with selected state and a content binding.

list.repair: Reuse a row component; declare scrolling, item data and fixed versus virtualized layout.

card.repair: Reuse the matching kit component, or compose and name a new reusable component from native children.

chart.line.repair: Bind explicit numeric series to a native line chart. SVG paths and raster crops cannot substitute for a chart.

chart.area.repair: Use a native data-bound area chart with declared baseline, axes and fill.

chart.candlestick.repair: Bind OHLC series to the native candlestick widget; retain financial values as data.

chart.donut.repair: Use a data-bound circular chart with category values, colors and an inner radius.

chart.radar.repair: Use a chart for radial quantitative data. A weather map needs a separately declared map widget; resolve ambiguous radar imagery first.

waveform.repair: Bind audio samples or an explicit fixture to a native waveform component.

progress.repair: Bind a normalized value to a reusable progress widget; verify fill changes when the value changes.

icon.repair: Use a matching kit icon or reference-derived SVG. A source crop requires a recorded visual feature that cannot be reproduced faithfully with the available vector renderer.

illustration.repair: Reconstruct simple artwork faithfully as SVG, or crop only the original illustration into an Image asset.

photo.repair: Use an original or separately generated image asset with documented crop, fit and clipping.

unknown.repair: Resolve this region's function from the brief and image before choosing a renderer.

chart.bar.repair: Bind categorical or floating intervals to a native bar plot; source paint is not a numerical chart.

chart.scatter.repair: Bind numerical coordinates and marker radii; preserve map artwork separately.
